changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'MapItem') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[MapItem]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [SourceIntersectID] [int] NOT NULL, [TargetIntersectID] [int] NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] NOT NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] NOT NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NOT NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NOT NULL, [Owner] [varchar](100) NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_MapItem] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_MapItem_SourceIntersectID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_MapItem_SourceIntersectID] ON [dbo].[MapItem] ( [SourceIntersectID] ASC ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_MapItem_TargetIntersectID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_MapItem_TargetIntersectID] ON [dbo].[MapItem] ( [TargetIntersectID] ASC ) END
